title.es: Aquel en el que Marta se culpa
title.en: The One Where Marta Blames Herself

description.es: Marta empieza a beber mucho. Le dice a Pelayo que quiere hablar con el detective. Llama al detective, y el detective dice las mismas cosas que Pelayo. Le dice a Begoña que ella tiene la culpa de todo. Dice que no va a la fábrica porque hay fotos que hizo Fina por todas partes, y verlas la haría sentir fatal. Al final del capítulo, vemos lo que Marta ha escrito sobre Fina en su diario.
description.en: Marta begins drinking heavily. She tells Pelayo that she wants to talk with the detective. She calls the detective, and the detective says the same things as Pelayo. She tells Begoña that she is to blame for everything. She says that she does not go to the factory because there are photos Fina took all over it, and seeing them would make her feel awful. At the end of the episode, we see what Marta has written about Fina in her diary.
